events.speaker: advocate
events.text: Thank you for calling Humana. This call is being recorded for quality assurance & training purposes.

events.speaker: advocate
events.text: If you like, there is an optional CenterWell pharmacy service with 90-day delivery. You can keep retail. It is not required.

events.speaker: member
events.text: No. Keep my retail pharmacy. I do not want delivery.

events.pauseLabel: T03B: optional comparison/enrollment stopped. No rebuttal.

events.speaker: advocate
events.text: Your decision today has no impact on your plan membership.

events.pauseLabel: T03B: closing applicable; no enrollment; no negative plan effect.
